sources.title: Key Questions on Energy and AI — Executive summary
sources.scope: System demand projections, efficiency and infrastructure constraints; not AI-only consumption or a floating-wind forecast.

sources.title: Energy supply for AI
sources.scope: 2025 report chapter; physical grid supply versus contractual procurement, not a dedicated FOWT-to-AI project.

sources.title: Data Centres and Flexibility
sources.scope: Public report summary on flexibility strategies and operational/economic barriers; full report not reviewed.

sources.title: A new milestone for smart, affordable electricity growth
sources.scope: Company-reported contracted demand-response capacity and partial ML-workload flexibility; not measured continuous curtailment.

sources.title: A milestone achievement in our journey to carbon negative
sources.scope: Company-reported annual renewable matching and contracted/online capacity; not hourly renewable supply to each facility.

sources.title: Significant update to ECMWF’s key forecasting systems IFS and AIFS goes live
sources.scope: Operational forecast-system release, including data-driven waves; not validation of a specific wind farm or marine operation.

sources.title: A digital twin for offshore wind energy – the first of its kind
sources.scope: DTWO project progress and planned modelling integration; not proof that all capabilities are commercially deployed.

sources.title: Hybrid Energy Systems Research
sources.scope: Hybrid-system modelling, controls and integration research; optimization does not by itself mean AI or demonstrate a built project.

sources.title: AI for Energy
sources.scope: Dated technical opportunity framing for grids and energy; not a statement of current policy or completed deployment.

sources.title: SUBSEE 4D
sources.scope: 2020–2023 project description and reported monitoring/ML achievements; not fleet-wide reliability or savings proof.

text.en: Training a model and running it both use computing hardware. The facility also needs cooling and electrical equipment. Where and when that electricity is supplied matters.
text.zh: 训练模型和运行模型都需要计算硬件；设施还需要冷却与电气设备。电力在何地、何时供应同样重要。

text.en: Models can turn weather, sensor and inspection data into forecasts or alerts. Engineers and operators decide how to act; a prediction is not a physical repair or new grid capacity.
text.zh: 模型可将天气、传感器与检测数据转化为预测或预警，再由工程师与运营方决定行动；预测本身不会修复设备，也不会新增电网容量。

title.zh: 部分 AI 用电可以调整

text.en: A data centre may shift or reduce eligible computing work when the grid needs relief. This depends on the workload and agreement; it does not make every AI service interruptible.
text.zh: 电网需要缓解压力时，数据中心可转移或减少符合条件的计算任务，但取决于任务类型与协议，并非所有 AI 服务都能中断。

mechanism.en: AI demand depends on task type, hardware efficiency and how much people use it. A more efficient model can still sit inside a growing electricity load.
mechanism.zh: AI 用电取决于任务类型、硬件效率及使用规模。单次任务更高效，整体用电仍可能增长。

reader.en: Ask whether an energy claim describes one task, one model or a whole data centre. Those are different measurement boundaries.
reader.zh: 先问：能耗说的是一次任务、一个模型，还是整个数据中心？三者的测量边界不同。

developer.en: Illustrative starting point: compare task completion, latency and measured energy for the same workload before choosing a model. Record hardware and measurement boundaries.
developer.zh: 示意起点：对同一任务比较完成质量、延迟与实测能耗，再选择模型；记录硬件与测量边界。

boundary.en: There is no universal electricity cost per prompt. Efficiency alone does not establish lower total demand.
boundary.zh: 不存在通用的“每次提示耗电量”；效率提升也不能单独证明总需求下降。

mechanism.en: Weather forecasts describe expected wind and sea conditions. Wind-farm models then translate weather into power or operating decisions. ECMWF now includes data-driven wave forecasts.
mechanism.zh: 天气预报描述预期风况与海况，再由风场模型转化为功率预测或作业决策。ECMWF 已加入数据驱动的海浪预报。

reader.en: A better global weather forecast is useful context. Ask whether it has been tested at the actual site and forecast horizon.
reader.zh: 更好的全球天气预报有参考价值，但仍应确认其是否在实际场址及目标预测时段经过检验。

developer.en: Illustrative starting point: compare forecasts with held-out site observations and a simple baseline. Separate typical conditions from rare storms and quantify missed-event costs.
developer.zh: 示意起点：使用未参与开发的场址观测，与简单基线比较；分别检验常态与罕见风暴，并评估漏报代价。

boundary.en: An operational weather product is not automatic permission to send a vessel offshore.
boundary.zh: 天气产品投入业务运行，不等于自动批准船舶出海。

mechanism.en: Sensors and engineering models can help identify abnormal behaviour and investigate component condition. Digital twins connect a representation of the asset with observations; not every twin uses AI.
mechanism.zh: 传感器与工程模型可帮助识别异常并研究部件状态。数字孪生将设备模型与观测连接起来，但并非每个孪生系统都使用 AI。

reader.en: Ask what was measured, whether a suspected fault was confirmed, and who decided to inspect or repair.
reader.zh: 应问：测到了什么？疑似故障是否被确认？由谁决定检查或维修？

developer.en: Illustrative starting point: combine time-aligned sensor records with maintenance outcomes. Test alerts against unseen operating periods and retain an engineer's review before intervention.
developer.zh: 示意起点：将时间对齐的传感器记录与维护结果结合；用未见过的运行时段检验预警，干预前保留工程师复核。

boundary.en: A monitoring demonstration does not establish fewer failures across every turbine or fleet.
boundary.zh: 监测示范不能证明所有风机或整个机队的故障都会减少。

mechanism.en: Wind, solar and storage can be studied together rather than as isolated assets. Forecasts inform scheduling; physical models and optimization test sizing and operating choices.
mechanism.zh: 可将风电、光伏与储能作为整体研究；预测为调度提供信息，物理模型与优化则检验规模配置和运行方案。

reader.en: Ask how the proposed mix serves the actual hourly load and connection limit, especially when renewable output stays low.
reader.zh: 应问：在可再生能源持续低出力时，拟议组合如何满足实际逐时负荷与接入限制？

developer.en: Illustrative starting point: evaluate historical time series with a physical dispatch model. Keep battery power, energy capacity and operating limits separate from any learned forecast.
developer.zh: 示意起点：用物理调度模型评估历史时间序列；将电池功率、能量容量与运行限制，同机器学习预测分开。

boundary.en: Optimization is not automatically AI. A hybrid simulation does not prove continuous renewable supply or a built project.
boundary.zh: 优化不自动等于 AI；混合系统仿真也不能证明持续可再生供电或项目已建成。

mechanism.en: Forecasting and system models support grid planning and operation. On the demand side, some computing can be rescheduled or reduced under agreed conditions.
mechanism.zh: 预测与系统模型辅助电网规划和运行；在需求侧，部分计算可按约定条件改期或减少。

reader.en: Ask which workloads can move, for how long, and whether the agreement has delivered a verified response.
reader.zh: 应问：哪些任务能调整？可持续多久？协议是否已产生经过核实的响应？

developer.en: Illustrative starting point: classify jobs by deadline and interruption tolerance, then test scheduling against grid signals with service-quality limits and an operator override.
developer.zh: 示意起点：按截止时间及中断容忍度分类任务，再结合电网信号测试调度；保留服务质量限制与人工覆盖控制。

boundary.en: Contracted flexibility is not energy generated. A response at one facility cannot be assumed at every data centre.
boundary.zh: 签约灵活性并非发电量；一个设施能响应，不代表所有数据中心都能做到。

title.zh: 浮式风电有哪些特殊之处？

mechanism.en: Floating wind adds moving platforms and submerged systems. Monitoring and models must account for moorings, dynamics and fatigue, alongside the turbine and weather.
mechanism.zh: 浮式风电增加了运动平台与水下系统；除了风机和天气，监测与模型还需考虑系泊、动力响应和疲劳。

reader.en: Ask whether evidence comes from floating equipment, fixed-bottom wind or a simulation. Transfer between them needs justification.
reader.zh: 应问：证据来自浮式设备、固定式风电，还是仿真？不同场景之间的迁移需要依据。

developer.en: Illustrative starting point: combine motion and mooring observations with a physics model. Test anomaly alerts against known operating changes before using them for maintenance planning.
developer.zh: 示意起点：将运动、系泊观测与物理模型结合；用于维护规划前，先针对已知运行变化检验异常预警。

boundary.en: These sources support engineering and monitoring context, not proof of an autonomous farm or an offshore AI data centre.
boundary.zh: 这些来源支持工程与监测背景，不能证明风场已自主运行，也不能证明海上 AI 数据中心已部署。

mechanism.en: A power purchase agreement is a commercial arrangement. A facility's physical electricity still depends on its local system. Annual renewable matching and hourly matching answer different questions.
mechanism.zh: 购电协议是一种商业安排；设施的物理用电仍取决于当地系统。年度可再生能源匹配与逐时匹配回答的是不同问题。

reader.en: Check the period, geography and boundary of a clean-power claim. Contracted projects and projects already supplying power are different states.
reader.zh: 检查清洁电力声明的时间周期、地理范围与边界；已签约项目与已经供电的项目是不同状态。

developer.en: Illustrative starting point: store contract dates, operating dates and hourly consumption separately. Compare like-for-like time periods before presenting a coverage claim.
developer.zh: 示意起点：分别保存合同日期、投运日期与逐时用电；在展示覆盖声明前，使用可比时间周期进行比较。

boundary.en: An annual corporate matching milestone does not establish that each AI task was powered by wind at that moment.
boundary.zh: 企业实现年度匹配里程碑，不能证明每个 AI 任务在当时都由风电供电。

meaning.en: Training fits a model to data; inference runs that model on new input. Both require computing.
meaning.zh: 训练是用数据拟合模型；推理是把模型用于新输入，两者都需要计算。

meaning.en: A forecast estimates what may happen. A decision chooses an action with costs, constraints and uncertainty.
meaning.zh: 预测估计可能发生什么；决策则结合成本、约束与不确定性选择行动。

meaning.en: A model linked to observations of an asset or system. It can combine physics and data; the label alone does not establish AI capability.
meaning.zh: 与设备或系统观测相连接的模型，可结合物理与数据；仅有“孪生”标签不能证明 AI 能力。

meaning.en: Changing electricity demand under agreed conditions. For computing, this may involve eligible jobs rather than pausing an entire service.
meaning.zh: 按约定条件改变用电需求；对计算而言，可能只调整符合条件的任务，而非暂停整个服务。

meaning.en: Power (MW) is a rate; energy (MWh) is an amount over time. A flexibility capacity figure is not annual renewable generation.
meaning.zh: 功率（MW）是速率，能量（MWh）是一定时间内的总量。灵活性容量不能当作年度可再生发电量。

meaning.en: Annual matching compares yearly totals. Hourly matching checks time alignment; both also need a geographic and accounting boundary.
meaning.zh: 年度匹配比较全年总量；逐时匹配检查时间对应关系，两者都需明确地理与核算边界。

title.en: Flexibility has limits as well as potential
title.zh: 灵活性既有潜力，也有边界

fact.en: IEA 4E EDNA's July report summary examines workload and infrastructure flexibility, with barriers that vary between data-centre types.
fact.zh: IEA 4E EDNA 七月报告摘要讨论任务与基础设施灵活性，指出不同数据中心类型面临不同障碍。

meaning.en: Ask which service can move and what it costs, rather than treating all computing as flexible.
meaning.zh: 应问哪些服务可调整、代价如何，而非假定所有计算都灵活。

boundary.en: Report-summary review; no universal deployable flexibility percentage.
boundary.zh: 仅复核报告摘要；未给出可普遍部署的灵活性比例。

title.en: AI weather models reach the wave forecast
title.zh: AI 天气模型延伸至海浪预报

fact.en: ECMWF's 12 May release introduced AIFS v2 alongside its physics-based IFS upgrade, including its first data-driven wave forecasts.
fact.zh: ECMWF 于 5 月 12 日同步升级物理预报系统 IFS 与 AIFS v2，并首次加入数据驱动的海浪预报。

meaning.en: A useful connection between weather AI and offshore decision support.
meaning.zh: 这是天气 AI 与海上决策支持之间的实际连接。

boundary.en: It does not establish site-specific accuracy or marine operating approval.
boundary.zh: 这不能证明具体场址精度，也不构成海上作业许可。

title.en: Offshore digital twins connect more disciplines
title.zh: 海上数字孪生连接更多学科

fact.en: ECMWF reported DTWO progress across Earth-system, wake, siting, turbine and grid modelling in April.
fact.zh: ECMWF 四月介绍了 DTWO 在地球系统、尾流、选址、风机及电网建模方面的进展。

meaning.en: The connection is between models and decisions across a wind project.
meaning.zh: 其联系在于将风电项目各环节的模型与决策连接起来。

boundary.en: Project progress and planned capabilities are not fleet-wide commercial proof.
boundary.zh: 项目进展与规划能力，不等于整个机队的商业运行证明。

title.en: More efficient AI can still mean more electricity
title.zh: AI 更高效，总用电仍可能增加

fact.en: IEA's April central projection puts all data-centre electricity demand at about 950 TWh in 2030, from 485 TWh in 2025.
fact.zh: IEA 四月中央情景预计，全部数据中心用电将从 2025 年的 485 TWh 增至 2030 年约 950 TWh。

meaning.en: Use a system view: efficiency, adoption and infrastructure can move in different directions.
meaning.zh: 需要系统视角：效率、使用规模与基础设施可呈现不同变化。

boundary.en: A conditional projection for all data centres, not AI-only demand or a wind-order forecast.
boundary.zh: 这是全部数据中心的条件性预测，不是 AI 单独用电量，也不是风电订单预测。

title.zh: 计算灵活性进入电力合同

fact.en: Google reported 1 GW of demand-response capacity in long-term US utility agreements in March, using part of its ML workload.
fact.zh: Google 三月表示，其美国长期电力协议已纳入 1 GW 需求响应容量，涉及部分机器学习任务。

meaning.en: This is a concrete commercial connection between computing and grid planning.
meaning.zh: 这是计算与电网规划之间具体的商业连接。

boundary.en: Company-reported contracted capacity, not continuous delivered reduction or a FOWT project.
boundary.zh: 这是企业报告的签约容量，并非持续实现的减载量，也不是浮式风电项目。

title.zh: 读懂可再生能源匹配的新闻标题

fact.en: Microsoft announced in February that it met its 2025 annual renewable-electricity matching goal. Its portfolio includes both operating and contracted future projects.
fact.zh: Microsoft 二月宣布已实现 2025 年年度可再生电力匹配目标；其组合同时包含已投运项目及未来签约项目。

meaning.en: Corporate buying can connect technology companies with renewable developers.
meaning.zh: 企业购电可将科技企业与可再生能源开发商连接起来。

boundary.en: Annual matching is not hourly renewable operation at every data centre.
boundary.zh: 年度匹配并不代表每个数据中心都逐时使用可再生能源。

title.zh: 在现有运行体系内改进工具

possibility.en: Weather and asset models could become more useful inputs to wind-farm planning and maintenance.
possibility.zh: 天气与设备模型可成为风场规划及维护中更有用的输入。

requires.en: Site validation, trustworthy observations and a clear route from an alert to a human decision.
requires.zh: 需要场址验证、可信观测，以及从预警到人工决策的明确流程。

watch.en: Repeated field results and documented decisions, not only model benchmarks.
watch.zh: 观察重复现场结果与有记录的决策，而不仅是模型基准成绩。

title.zh: 协调可再生能源、储能与计算

possibility.en: Eligible computing could adapt to power-system conditions while hybrid supply is planned around the actual load.
possibility.zh: 可调整的计算任务可适应电力系统条件，混合供电则围绕实际负荷规划。

requires.en: Workload limits, grid agreements and an operating plan for low renewable output.
requires.zh: 需要任务限制、电网协议及低可再生出力时的运行方案。

watch.en: Verified responses, service performance and time-matched supply records.
watch.zh: 观察已核实的响应、服务表现及时间匹配供电记录。

title.en: Floating wind serves computing through a wider system
title.zh: 浮式风电通过更大的系统服务计算

possibility.en: Floating wind could contribute to grid-connected compute supply. Moving servers offshore is a separate proposal, not a necessary next step.
possibility.zh: 浮式风电可参与向并网计算设施供电；把服务器搬上海是独立提议，并非必然下一步。

requires.en: A financed wind project, connection and supply arrangements; offshore compute would need separate marine, data-link and continuity evidence.
requires.zh: 需要完成融资的风电项目、接入与供电安排；海上计算还需单独的海工、数据链路及连续性证据。

watch.en: Named operating projects and verifiable contracts. No integrated FOWT-to-AI deployment is established by this collection.
watch.zh: 观察具名运行项目与可核实合同；本资料集尚不能确立一体化浮式风电到 AI 部署。
